title: Home practical guide and safety card: yeast balloon
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The periodic table (8F); breathing and respiration (8C)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 41 (Home practical guide and safety card: yeast balloon (portal worksheet; warm tap water only, no lids, adult present))
intro: Lesson 41: Fermentation: yeast, sugar and a balloon. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how temperature affects yeast
equipment: Cold, warm and hot tap water (100 ml each)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Label the bottles cold, warm and hot
Add 2 teaspoons of sugar and the yeast to each
Add 100 ml of the matching tap water; no lids
Stretch a balloon over each neck
Measure each balloon's circumference every 10 minutes for 40 minutes
Record and explain which grew most

questions.q: Big question: why does dough rise in a warm kitchen but not the fridge?
questions.a: Yeast respires faster when warm, making more carbon dioxide.
